experiments.label: prompt-probe-01

experiments.label: prompt-probe-02
experiments.purpose: Same 32 paired cases. Extend the established Sanskrit prompt with grammatical fields; no task semantics or output requirement change.

experiments.label: composition-pilot-02
experiments.purpose: 480 fresh development tasks, 80 each across six harder constructions, common v3 prompt after 31/32 diagnostic completions. Sample all cases regardless of previous model success; no final labels.

experiments.label: interaction-pilot-01

experiments.label: pada-prefix-candidate-01
experiments.purpose: 200 fresh development tasks in four predeclared cells: Parasmaipada/Atmanepada crossed with one/two prefixes. Same audited intensive-causative aorist scope. Test added grammatical constraints for difficulty margin, before any held-out model calls.

mechanical_audit.family_definition: Exact Dhatupatha citation including markers, plus gana; not an etymological lemma split.
mechanical_audit.scope: Full regeneration, semantic fields, all accepted gold variants, prompt identity, split membership and declared sampling exclusions.
mechanical_audit.limits: Does not independently certify Sanskrit correctness, empirical difficulty, contamination absence or benchmark sampling precision.

experiments.label: bench-calibration-01
experiments.purpose: Fresh development calibration for a candidate tier; no score-based item filtering. Opus first while current Astra pilots process. Astra pairing will be decided from returned pilot evidence and remaining caps.

experiments.label: deep-creation-pilot-01

experiments.label: paradigm-pilot-01
experiments.purpose: Generate two or four explicitly requested forms of the same derived root. Not a full Sanskrit paradigm. No source word or correction trace.

experiments.label: deep-benedictive-calibration-01

experiments.label: contrast-pilot-01
experiments.purpose: Different derived stems require different transformations. The shared-stem paradigm pilot showed nearly perfectly correlated errors, so simply adding its inflectional endings did not help.

experiments.label: krdanta-pilot-01
experiments.purpose: Interactions between derived stems, participial num suppression, suffix-specific stem changes and nominal endings may yield new one-form difficulty. This is a hypothesis, not a threshold guarantee.
experiments.staging: Opus first; identical Astra tasks only if useful and affordable.

experiments.label: contrast-sanskrit-prompt-02

Explicit Sanskrit verbal root (dhatu) phrasing follows the established v2 template. Treatment changes contextual wording, not only one token. Excluded from pooled fresh-task construction estimates.

experiments.label: paradigm-dhatu-word-probe-03

experiments.label: samasa-template-probe-03

experiments.label: independent-creation-pilot-01

experiments.stage: Opus first;pair Astra only if completion and difficulty are promising and cap permits.

experiments.label: unadi-pilot-01

experiments.label: unadi-sanskrit-probe-02

experiments.label: independent-sanskrit-probe-02

experiments.label: passive-pilot-01
